recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future SupplyDelivery fixes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator rather than this core checkout; separately audit FHIR-42947 or FHIR-45506 only if their migration to the external IG needs a dedicated decision.
issue_request: FHIR-38818 asked to clarify that SupplyDelivery covers shipment/dispatch as well as receipt/reception. Its Applied/Persuasive with Modification disposition required SupplyDelivery.status 1..1, a required summary SupplyDelivery.stage with an extensible stage value set, an extensible binding for SupplyDelivery.type, shipment/reception scope-and-usage examples, a movement-focused resource short definition, and deferral of dispatch/reception core profiles to FHIR-45506.
initial_application: The source history explicitly applied FHIR-38818 in commit acfe1809cf, which removed draft dispatch/receipt profiles from the SupplyDelivery implementation guide, changed SupplyDelivery.stage from Coding to CodeableConcept, and adjusted the implementer note. The current local SupplyDelivery source copy also contains the required status cardinality, stage element and binding, extensible type binding, movement short definition, and dispatch/reception narrative.
additional_context: Later related changes, including FHIR-42947 and FHIR-45506, refined SupplyDelivery boundaries and workflow guidance without reversing the FHIR-38818 model. In November 2025, commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyDelivery and related OO resources from active source/fhir.ini configuration and rewired active core pages to the OO Incubator IG. Current fhir.ini has no SupplyDelivery build entry, while active core narrative links SupplyDelivery to build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. Editing source/supplydelivery would not affect the current core build, and the live external HL7/oo-incubator source carries the relevant FHIR-38818 semantics for stage, dispatch, receipt, and multiple-stage usage.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue refined SupplyDelivery/Transport boundaries and supports the same dispatch/reception model, but was not decided here.
Split from FHIR-38818 to handle dispatch/reception profiles and workflow guidance; not decided here because it is a separate applied issue.
